name: stca
description: Learn and save readable STCA/WRAcc polymer rules, screen candidates, or generate and verify repeat units with built-in prompts.

interface.longDescription: Upload polymer data to compare readable STCA and WRAcc rules, retain both methods and save reusable frozen rules. Screen candidates with paper, open-data or saved rules, or select a rule from the directory to generate and verify structures. Each requested tier includes the original-table screening results and failed conditions. Original star-containing SMILES are preserved. Return to the main menu after saving; the AI assistant manages the compatible CPU backend.
defaultPrompt: Learn and save rules from my data.
Screen candidates with my selected rules.
Generate candidates with my saved rules.
